servers.title: Choose your server
servers.looking: Looking for Pley on your network…
servers.noneFound: No servers found. Make sure this TV and the server are on the same network.
servers.forgetHint: Hold OK on a saved server to forget it.
servers.forgetBody: Pley signs this TV out of it and deletes what it saved from it.
servers.unencrypted: {{address}} isn't encrypted: what you watch could be read on the way. Use its https address if it has one, or press Connect again to go ahead anyway.

problems.badAddress: Enter an address such as nas, 192.168.1.20 or pley.example.com.
problems.notPley: Something answers at {{address}}, but it isn't Pley.

link.title: Sign in to Pley
link.twoStepRequired: This server requires two-step sign-in: your phone sets it up if you haven't yet.
link.approveIntro: {{name}}'s profile needs its password: approve this code on a phone signed in to Pley, and pick {{name}} there.
link.anotherIntro: Approve this code on a phone signed in to Pley, and pick the profile there.
link.retrying: Can't reach the server. Trying again in {{seconds}} s
link.expired: Code expired: press OK for a new one
link.scan: Scan the code with your phone
link.sameWifi: Your phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as this TV.
link.otherDevice: Or open Pley on a signed-in device → Link a device

profiles.title: Who's watching?
profiles.numberKeys: You can also type with the number keys on your remote.
profiles.throttled: Too many wrong PINs: try again in a few minutes.
profiles.pinLocked: This profile's PIN is locked after too many wrong tries. Its owner or an administrator can reset it.
profiles.notAllowed: You can't switch to this profile.
profiles.needsPassword: This profile needs its password: sign in again to use it.
profiles.unusable: This profile can't be used from the app.

oauth.invalidClient: the server doesn't know this app
oauth.unauthorizedClient: the server doesn't let this app sign in this way
oauth.invalidScope: the server refused what this app asked for
oauth.invalidRequest: the server didn't understand the request
oauth.unsupportedGrantType: the server doesn't take this kind of sign-in

errors.unencrypted: this server's address isn't on your network and its connection isn't encrypted: open it by its https address to sign in
errors.tooOld: this server is too old for this app
errors.noCodes: this server can't sign in TVs with a code yet: update it
errors.unknownApp: this server doesn't know Pley's TV apps yet: update it
errors.unreachable: the server can't be reached: check its address and that it's on
errors.callsItself: this server calls itself {{address}}: open it by that address, or check the proxy in front of it passes Host
errors.signInElsewhere: this server sends apps to another address to sign in: Pley doesn't
errors.approveElsewhere: this server sends people to another address to approve TVs: Pley doesn't
errors.busy: too many TVs are signing in here right now: try again in a minute
errors.codeUsed: this code doesn't work anymore: get a new one
errors.unreadable: the server's answer can't be read: try again
errors.widerScope: the server allowed more than this app asks for: signed out
errors.signInEnded: sign-in ended: choose the server again
